Hi squad, it's Dana. Here's the plan for Margaret River. We're going to leave from the school parking lot at five a.m. on Saturday, so set your alarm. I'm going to drive the van, and Tom's dad is going to follow in his car with the extra boards. The drive is about three hours, and we're going to stop for breakfast at a rest stop in Bunbury. On Saturday night we're going to sleep at a campsite near the beach, so pack a sleeping bag and something warm. It gets cold at night down there. The campsite is eighty dollars for the group, so that's sixteen dollars each. Oh, and one more thing. If you get carsick, tell me, and I'll give you the front seat. See you on Saturday.

Hey mate, it's Kai. It's Friday night and I'm checking the list. Jess is bringing the first aid kit, Harper is bringing the speaker, and you're bringing the snacks, right? Don't forget the banana bread. I'm going to be at the school at a quarter to five, because I'm going to put the boards on the roof rack before everybody arrives. Can you help me? I'll buy you a hot chocolate at the rest stop. Oh, and bad news. The forecast says it's going to rain on Saturday morning. But don't worry, the swell is going to be big on Sunday, for the first heat. Okay, I'll stop talking now. Go to sleep. Big day tomorrow.
